cs.m: Jennings Super Task Big and Tall
cs.t:
I'm a web developer and I sit about 6-8 hours on a normal day, and when I'm gaming or writing code for fun it can easily reach 18 hours uninterrupted (except restroom breaks). Over the many years and different office chairs I've finally found the holy grail: ===> Serta Smart Layers Jennings Super Task Big and Tall (NOTE: there seems to be another version without the word "Super" that I have also purchased and its bottom cushion/back support is sub-par.  do be vigilant) - Supportive, soft leather (or substitute I dunno) cushions
- Good neck/head support
- Comfortable arm rests (though after 6 years have begun to flatten) Good luck!
cs.th: Ask HN: Have you found a good desk chair?

cs.t: the best chair I've ever owned, if you like laid-back posture   https://www.officedepot.com/a/products/304556/Serta-Smart-La...  it's only $220 and much more comfortable than $1400 Aeron that kind of forces you to sit in a certain way, plus you can fold and seat on your leg if you're into that kinda thing
